data_volume.reached_rule_note: Paired bootstrap over (subset seed, sampler seed) for the per-fraction mean relative reconstruction. A fraction is reached only if the CI lower bound clears T_d minus the frozen control noise width written by calibrate-targets. A crossing interval is inconclusive. Gates stay on the nominal grid f; reports also show the realized overall input fraction after upward FK closure.

f1_regression_bound.note: Loaded by reference from default.json at gate time; not duplicated in this policy.

privacy.note: A candidate privacy failure anywhere rejects. A baseline privacy failure is inconclusive (reason baseline_privacy). Completeness covers both builds.
